body_lead: Tamil Nadu Rolls Out AI Assistive Devices Scheme On 29 October 2026, the Tamil Nadu government announced assistance for persons with disabilities to obtain modern assistive devices, including AI-based aids. A broader first phase has an allocation of Rs. 125 crore. The specific AI-assisted devices scheme will cover 1,000 beneficiaries, with a budget of Rs. 3 crore. Devices and eligibility Covered equipment includes sports prostheses, electrically operated upper-limb prostheses, cochlear implant batteries and beds with commode facilities.
